purpose: Compares each party's own-language press and third-country press on the same conflict events and labels claims corroborated, framed, disputed or single source; publishes a daily relationship temperature per country pair from GDELT events.
access: Free, no account. Open data CSVs (temperatures, outlet registry, naming choices) under CC BY 4.0, and an RSS feed of daily pages.
dashboard_use: Ingested: the collector reads the temperatures CSV and RSS feed hourly (snap-lanes, /api/context?type=lanes). Each theater whose countries match a Lanes pair shows the 7-day temperature, its change and the latest daily page, with a link to the pair's bridge page.
limits: Eight country pairs. Temperatures are machine-coded GDELT events, so they measure how events were reported. Lanes labels its daily pages AI-compiled and not human-reviewed. When read on 2026-10-19 the newest rows were dated 2026-10-06.
verified: Site, /about, /data and feed.xml read 2026-10-19; library entry

purpose: Tracks ships on eight authorities' sanctions lists by terrestrial AIS and records identity changes, silences, ship-to-ship meetings and calls at restricted ports.
access: Free to browse with 7 days of history; a free account gives 14 days; CSV export and full history on Pro. No API is published.
dashboard_use: Linked: offered as a pivot from each theater that holds a mapped oil chokepoint (Red Sea, Hormuz, South China Sea, the Danish and Turkish straits). The site is a JavaScript application and no stable vessel or map link pattern could be confirmed, so the link opens its map.
limits: Terrestrial AIS only, so ships far offshore drop out. History starts 2026-08-01. AIS is self-reported and can be spoofed; silences and meetings are leads to check.
verified: Library entry; site root read 2026-10-19 (JavaScript shell only)

purpose: Exact-string and regex search over the homepage source of about 131M domains, for shared trackers, frameworks and code fingerprints.
access: Freemium; an account for full results; CSV export and API on paid access.
dashboard_use: Held: searching the web for pages that copy the organization's code or tracking IDs is brand-impersonation discovery, which waits on Sean's decision.
limits: Homepages only; crawl schedule sets freshness; weak fingerprints give false positives.

purpose: Maps, current and historical satellite imagery and other geospatial layers with comparison, annotation and timelapse tools.
access: Viewing is free; downloading free imagery needs an account; commercial imagery is paid.
dashboard_use: Linked: offered as an imagery pivot from every theater. The site is a JavaScript application and no coordinate link pattern could be confirmed, so the link opens its atlas.
limits: Coverage, resolution and dates vary by place and provider; visible change needs interpretation and corroboration.
verified: Library entry; soar.earth redirects to soaratlas.com (read 2026-10-19)

purpose: Checks a wallet against issuer blacklists for freezeable assets (USDT, USDC, PAXG, XAUt) and reports sanctions-related exposure and freeze or release activity.
access: Free public checks; API, bulk scan and alerts are on its pricing and developer pages.
dashboard_use: Reference: no wallet indicators reach the dashboard yet. It becomes the wallet pivot once the planned ransom-payment feed lands.
limits: Its homepage does not name its data sources; results are indicators for investigation and the status can change.

purpose: Search engine over crawled domains and pages with network, technology, country and favicon-hash pivots; human-readable /site/<domain> and /network/<ASN> pages.
access: Free. Search and the data API need no key (IP rate limits); domain profile, subdomain and favicon endpoints need a free key (30 a minute, 1,000 a day).
dashboard_use: Linked: each mapped infrastructure node offers its autonomous system on cl0q (/network/<ASN>). Favicon-hash search for look-alike sites waits on Sean's decision.
limits: Partial index of a 100M-domain goal; freshness and retention not published.

purpose: Browser front end for username, email, domain and IP footprint checks across public sources.
access: Free, no account. Independent of the SpiderFoot project.
dashboard_use: Reference: a scan tool. The dashboard is a reporting surface, so any results would come in only through Sean's own-estate ingest.
limits: Matches can be false or stale; IP geolocation is approximate; coverage depends on third parties.

purpose: Observed DNS resolutions searchable by domain or wildcard, IP or CIDR (/24, /48) and ASN, newest first, with CSV download.
access: Free public searches under fair use, each behind a small in-browser proof-of-work; its page metadata names a public API and Python and Go SDKs, which the library entry does not list.
dashboard_use: Reference: a candidate for watching the organization's own domains for new resolutions once Sean sets the watchlist. No query link pattern is published.
limits: Logs each search with the network's ASN and country and a daily-rotating hash of the address, kept a year. Collection method not stated.

purpose: Name and alias search over the OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists and the U.S. consolidated list, with links to source records.
access: Public search free; screening API and sandbox need an account.
dashboard_use: Reference: the dashboard reads the authoritative OFAC Recent Actions listing directly (snap-ofac, /api/context?type=ofac) and links each action to Treasury. SanctionsKit stays the analyst's name search.
limits: Exact name words, no screening score; a shared name proves nothing; not affiliated with the publishers.

purpose: Exact-string and regex search over stored HTML and first-party JavaScript, for shared tracking IDs, scripts and injected snippets.
access: Free; the JSON API needs a key issued on request.
dashboard_use: Held: like SearchWebCode, searching for sites that carry the organization's identifiers waits on Sean's decision.
limits: New index (first crawl September 2026), five pages a site, weekly recrawl, no client-side rendering.

purpose: Directory of public Telegram channels, groups and bots with categories, languages and scores.
dashboard_use: Reference: a discovery aid for channels hacktivist and extortion groups announce on. No Telegram collection runs without a collection decision.
limits: Mixed-content directory with AI-generated summaries and scores; operator not established.

purpose: Country profiles, maps, codes, capitals and languages, with links to official and local sources.
dashboard_use: Linked: each theater lists a country profile link for every country in it, from slugs read off its countries index.
limits: Compiled reference that may lag; maps are not boundary evidence.
verified: Library entry; countries index and sample profiles read 2026-10-19
